errors.detail: The defining feature is absent. The blueprint draws TWO vertical pleat folds dropping from the yoke seam, one on each side, offset laterally toward each shoulder blade (drawing coords: marks at x=59.5 and x=132.5 about a body centre of 95.5, i.e. roughly 60% of the way from centre back to the side seam). In the photo the back panel below the yoke is smooth and featureless: contrast-boosted crops and a per-column brightness profile of the yoke-to-mid-back band show only soft drape shading and a faint centre-spine crease, with no pressed fold, no fold shadow pair, and no pleat originating at the yoke seam on either side.

What was delivered is a plain clean shirt back, which is the sibling option on this same field (back-napoli-no-dart / clean back). A customer comparing 'Side Pleat' against the no-pleat option would see no difference, so the image fails the one-second identification requirement and would mis-sell the option.

No pleat construction of any kind is visible: no crease line, no fold edge catching light, and no stitch/tack where each pleat is caught into the yoke seam. The yoke seam itself reads as a soft tonal change rather than a stitched seam.

Not framed on the upper back/yoke as specified. The frame runs from the top of the model's head to below the hip and includes dark charcoal trousers with visible waistband, belt loops and a rear pocket occupying roughly the bottom fifth of the image; the yoke-and-pleat zone the option is about occupies only a small central band, well under the 40-80% dominance target.
Because no pleats exist, lateral offset from centre back, pleat depth and pleat length cannot be verified against the drawing at all.
